name: co-VC dimension
definition: The **coVC number** $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal H)$ is the largest $|S|$ for which some $S\subseteq\mathcal X$ and $T\subseteq S$ satisfy $$T\notin\mathcal H_{|S}\quad\text{and}\quad T\mathbin{\triangle}\{x\}\in\mathcal H_{|S}\quad\text{for every }x\in S.$$ Such a configuration is a hollow star.
description: The maximum dimension of a hollow star in a coordinate projection. It is also called the hollow star number, dual Helly number, or consistency dimension (up to the conventional shift used for Helly numbers).
graph_summary: Largest projected hollow star: an unrealizable labeling whose every one-coordinate flip is realizable. Also called hollow star number/co-VC dimension.
comments: Also called the **consistency dimension**: it is the least $k$ such that every nonmember admits a labeled sample of size at most $k$ inconsistent with the class. This is equivalent to the hollow-star/co-VC formulation. For intersection-closed or extremal classes (hence maximum classes), $\mathrm{coVC}\leq\mathrm{VC}+1$; affine halfspaces in $\mathbb R^d$ with both constants attain $d+2=\mathrm{VC}+1$.
origin_references: Introduced as co-VC dimension in \cite{kane2019communication}; the equivalent dual Helly number and hollow-star formulation are developed in \cite{bousquet2020proper}. The consistency-dimension terminology appears in \cite{hegedHus1995generalized}.

monotonic.proof: For $n\ge3$, the full cube $\{0,1\}^{[n]}$ has $\mathrm{coVC}=0$, whereas its singleton subfamily has $\mathrm{coVC}=n$: the all-zero trace is missing and all of its one-coordinate neighbours occur.  Thus passage to a subfamily can increase co-VC dimension.

p_monotonic.proof: A hollow star in a projection $(\mathcal H_{|T})_{|S}$ is exactly a hollow star in $\mathcal H_{|S}$ for $S\subseteq T$.  Since co-VC maximizes over coordinate restrictions, projecting first cannot increase it.

c_monotonic.proof: A hollow star in a conditioned fibre can be lifted by adjoining the fixed labels.  It is then a hollow star in the original class, so conditioning cannot increase co-VC dimension.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, doubly monotonicity requires both subfamily monotonicity and projection monotonicity; the recorded failure of one of them rules it out.

strictly_monotonic.proof: By definition, strictly monotonicity requires both doubly monotonicity and strict c-monotonicity; the recorded failure of one of them rules it out.
